## Description
Describe the feature and the motivation behind it.

## Use Case
Explain the use case and why this feature would be beneficial.

**Example:**
> As a developer, I want [feature] so that I can [benefit/outcome].

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any other approaches?

## Additional Context
Add any other context or attachments (mockups, diagrams, references).

## Related Issues
Link any related issues with `#issue_number`
